descriptions.d10d_rgb8_tile_801d79f0: Copy the 4x4 block at (x, y) of a 24-bit RGB image (bytes r, g, b; pitch bytes per row) into one 64-byte GX RGBA8 tile with alpha 255: alpha/red pairs in the first 32 bytes and green/blue pairs in the second 32, 8 bytes per row. Edge blocks are clipped (unsigned extents, at most 4) and clipped texels keep their bytes.
